metadata.description: Static strategic interests used by the Strategic Pressure Engine. These values represent long-term national interests and do not change during daily execution.

interests.name: Israel security
interests.description: Maintain Israel's security and military superiority.

interests.name: Protection of US forces
interests.description: Protect US military personnel, bases and regional assets.

interests.name: Freedom of navigation
interests.description: Maintain secure maritime routes including the Strait of Hormuz.

interests.name: Prevent Iranian nuclear weapon capability
interests.description: Limit or delay Iran's military nuclear programme.

interests.name: Regional deterrence
interests.description: Maintain credible military deterrence against Iran and its proxies.

interests.name: Protection of regional partners
interests.description: Support Gulf partners and other regional allies.

interests.name: Global energy security
interests.description: Reduce disruption to global energy markets.

interests.name: Regime survival
interests.description: Ensure survival and stability of the Islamic Republic.

interests.name: Strategic deterrence
interests.description: Maintain credible military deterrence against the United States and Israel.

interests.name: Preserve nuclear programme
interests.description: Protect strategic nuclear infrastructure and capabilities.

interests.name: Missile capability
interests.description: Maintain and develop long-range missile forces.

interests.name: Regional proxy network
interests.description: Maintain influence through regional partner organisations.

interests.name: Regional influence
interests.description: Preserve strategic influence across the Middle East.

interests.name: Hormuz leverage
interests.description: Retain the ability to influence maritime traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.

interests.name: Avoid regime-destroying war
interests.description: Avoid military escalation threatening state survival.
